title: Apple’s smart home camera reportedly won’t record video
excerpt: Apple’s upcoming smart home camera is reportedly taking a very different approach to products from Ring and Google Nest, with the device designed to understand what is happening around the home without recording video for users to watch back. Bloomberg’s […]
